steps.heading: Fisheye table of contents
steps.text: Every heading in the document, foldable — the quiet stretches collapse so a long draft fits on one screen. Click any row to jump; the search box above filters it by verbatim text, keywords, tags, or meaning.

steps.heading: Fisheye vs full document
steps.text: 🔍 collapses distant text so you see the map; 📄 renders a normal scrolling window around your focus instead. Toggle any time — it's just how this pane reads, not a different draft.

steps.heading: The focus
steps.text: The block you're pointed at, expanded in full with its immediate neighbours. This is what a change request from the panel on the right acts on by default — navigate to a paragraph and it becomes the thing being changed.

steps.heading: Pin for context
steps.text: 📌 pins a paragraph as reading context for the writer without making it the thing being changed — "read this while you work." Pin as many as you like; unpin all clears them.

steps.heading: The request box
steps.text: Describe the change in your own words and send it. It works on your pinned paragraphs as context and the current focus as the target — mark, describe, send is the whole workflow.
